answer: A workable design: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the walnut to sunk effort, uses the sparrow as an corroborating signal, then requires a hollow before any payout.
